body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN009231304 (POP5 HOMOLOG, RIBONUCLEASE P_MRP SUBUNIT (PTHR48414))


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly Pop5 (FBgn0036696)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source
 
This node is annotated with 'contributes_to [ribonuclease MRP activity' and contributes_to 'ribonuclease P activity' based on source annotation to yeast S000000031|UniProtKB=P28005.
But POP5 is a non-catalytic subunit of the ribonuclease P/MRP complex, so shouldn't have this annotation. Please remove.
title: PTN009231304 (POP5 HOMOLOG, RIBONUCLEASE P_MRP SUBUNIT (PTHR48414))
